name: Midnight Illusionist Dedication

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

prerequisites: ability to cast spells from spell slots
text:
Access member of the Midnight Guard

---
In preparation for greater heights, you've learned to control your own shadow. You can manipulate the size, shape and movements of your shadow as you desire, though it can't stretch beyond twice its normal size. In addition, you can use your shadow to increase your reach to 10 feet when delivering spells with a range of touch.

You also have access to the School of Shadow Veils. If you're a prepared spellcaster, you can prepare spells from this school, and if you're a spontaneous spellcaster, you can add them to your spell repertoire. These spells share the tradition, spell attack modifier, and spell DC of the spells you used to meet this archetype's prerequisites, as do any focus spells granted by midnight illusionist feats.
